text: 迷你裙已經 out 咗啦。

english.text: As a result of the war, many people died.

text: 唔好擺到你啲嘢周圍都係。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Please let me know the result by telephone.

jyutping: m4 goi1 nei5 daa2 din6 waa2 waa6 go3 git3 gwo2 bei2 ngo5 teng1 aa1。
text: 唔該你打電話話個結果俾我聽吖。

author: nickyeow

english.text: "Would you mind shutting the door?" "No, not at all."

jyutping: 「nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 sau2 saan1 maai4 dou6 mun4 aa3？」「ho2 ji5，gang2 hai6 ho2 ji5 laa1。」
text: 「你可唔可以幫手閂埋道門呀？」「可以，梗係可以啦。」

author: nickyeow

english.text: There are six people including him.

jyutping: gai2 maai4 keoi5 jau5 luk6 go3 jan4。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Most Hollywood movies have a happy ending.

jyutping: ho4 lei5 wut6 di1 din6 jing2 do1 sou3 dou1 hai6 daai6 tyun4 jyun4 git3 guk6。
text: 荷李活啲電影多數都係大團圓結局。

english.text: Over ten thousand messages are sent every second on Facebook.

jyutping: hai2 Facebook mui5 jat1 miu5 dou1 jau5 ciu1 gwo3 jat1 maan6 go3 seon3 sik1 faat3 ceot1。
text: 喺Facebook每一秒都有超過一萬個訊息發出。

text: 仆街，我將屋企條鎖匙擺撚咗去邊？
